name: Natural Iris Reveal
description: A slow zoom from your selfie into your clearer eye and back out. Only your photo's own pixels are used: nothing on your face is generated or changed. Photos without enough detail in the eye are refused before rendering.

photo.label: A sharp, full-resolution selfie (straight from your phone)

license: YuNet (MIT) finds the eyes; everything else is plain image processing on your own photo
